body.text: Adds a `catalog.album` record (the work-level grouping of pressings, keyed by Discogs master and MusicBrainz release group), an optional `release.album` ref, and an adopt-or-mint path that creates the album whenever a release with a Discogs master id is minted. `release.master` is deprecated rather than renamed, so `lexicon-check` reports the change as non-breaking. Implements the proposal in ADR 4.

title.text: feat: add catalog.album, mint it from Discogs masters, and deprecate release.master
